note: Untitled doc §19: building/service stops on the stage map. One stop per stage at most, placed with its own seeded roll so older seeds keep their maps. Status is honest: only "supported" services can appear. Others are listed so the tracker shows what is left.

services.name: Pokémon Center
services.blurb: Paid care: heal, cure status or revive. A clear menu, not a free full heal.

services.name: Move Tutor
services.blurb: Teach one move a Pokémon could learn by TM or tutor. The move it forgets is shown first.

services.name: Move Reminder
services.blurb: Relearn a level-up move the Pokémon has forgotten or skipped.

services.name: Research Lab
services.blurb: Pay for field research (Research Points at the end of the run) or scan the map for hidden "?" stops.

services.name: Trade Post
services.blurb: Swap a party Pokémon for one of similar strength. Special forms are only offered here and at events.

services.name: Scout Tower
services.blurb: Reveals the stage boss's specialty so you can prepare.

services.name: Specialist Mart
services.blurb: Evolution items your party can use right now. Nothing that no one on your team could use.

services.name: Training Dojo
services.blurb: One vitamin-style training session for one Pokémon (no random changes).

services.name: Rival Meeting Place
services.blurb: A quiet place to size up a rival's team, or to ask for a one-stage truce.

services.name: Pokémon Lodge
services.blurb: Rest and bond with one Pokémon: friendship rises. Once per stop, no combat buff.

services.name: Nursery
services.blurb: Buy a Mystery Egg. It hatches into a first-stage Pokémon after 3 stages. One per stop.

services.name: Relic Shrine
services.blurb: Trade a point of one attribute for two of another for this run. Both sides are shown first.

services.name: Auction House
services.blurb: Bid money on a small item pool. A bid only costs money if it wins; one bid per stop.

services.name: Event Hall
services.blurb: The bulletin board: which event editions count for this run.

services.name: Raid Observatory
services.blurb: Reveals every raid den on this stage map: the boss, its tier and what it asks.
